resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Central US page gives 50 feet (15.2 m, the value kept in the record) for the tower erected in 1924. A 1935 survey recovery note describes a 60-foot Forest Service tower centered over the station. The sources do not say whether these are the same structure, so the story reports both heights.

notes_for_editor: Two sources. The NGS datasheet (retrieved 2026-10-10) is the only source for the 1916 station, the 1935 60-foot tower, the 1956 teardown, the 1972 footing and the 1989 site note. The 1924 date and the Removed status come only from the Central US page, which is a fan site that reproduces NGS notes. Brief coordinates 34.768, -93.3461 match the NGS NAD 83 position (34 46 05.41 N, 093 20 45.29 W) to about 0.0002 degree. Access is left out of facts: the 1989 note gives U.S. government ownership and a route on Forest Service roads but says nothing about public visits. No staffing, fire or photo evidence was found. No source describes the clearing after 1989. Brief status gone and height 15.2 m are kept; the 60-foot figure is noted, not used to change the record.
